glossary.CuNi: language — write once, print 53 targets. Same stdout or refuse. Native seats: Python, Go, JS, TS, C, C++, Rust. Bank arm: paste N get X. Studio $0. Closed-app grant $490/yr. Per-check API: first 100 checks/month free, then $0.05 per check. v0.10.0.
glossary.Chamber: two-key protocol for storing a JSON secret. Cloak license $20/mo · $200/yr. 24-hour try. Open existing seals with both keys; opening already-sealed blobs free forever.
glossary.Agent-Rider: signed agent identity L0–L4. Solo $12 · Team $49 · Fleet $199 per month. Overage $0.02 per verification, customer-set cap, alert at 80%. Rider Solo included in Lab Pass.
glossary.PCC: lossless compressor through your tools. Metered $0.25/GB of input, first 1 GB/month free; Pro $25/mo (100 GB included, then $0.20/GB). Dual-licensed public source, or a paid grant to ship closed.
glossary.TRUSTREAM: live logs on the PCC plan.
glossary.Suite: PCC meter — first 1 GB/month free, then $0.25/GB of input. Customer-set cap (default $25), alert at 80%. Not a product card.
glossary.Lab Pass: Chamber year + Rider Solo year + PSI Meter 1 seat year + Warrant add-on year for 365 days, $495. PCC/compression out.
glossary.Access: entitlement claim after Stripe or x402. Not a codec dump.
glossary.pulsar: free GPLv3 compressor you run on your own machine. Closed embed via unified grant $490/product/year.
glossary.Warrant: signed mandate and receipts bound to a Rider. $8/month add-on to Solo ($80/year); included in Team and Fleet. No standalone SKU.
